# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 2A, Red Sea / Holy Land / Ethiopia & Trajan's Canal (1365-1550, oe_red_). Generated by gen_red_sea_prequel.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# Initialize Red Sea / Holy Land / Ethiopia & Trajan's Canal global state (idempotent).
oe_red_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_init } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_init value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_on value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_stage value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_holy_stance value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_eth_bond value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_spice_access value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_canal_stage value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_tariff_mode value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_compact_mode value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_cnt value = 0 }
    }
}

# Bilateral opinion helper between Roman host (ROM/BYZ) and MAM.
oe_red_apply_byz_mam_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM country_exists = c:MAM }
        c:ROM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:MAM } }
        c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ country_exists = c:MAM }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:MAM } }
        c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Bilateral opinion helper between Roman host (ROM/BYZ) and ETH.
oe_red_apply_byz_eth_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM country_exists = c:ETH }
        c:ROM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ETH } }
        c:ETH = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ country_exists = c:ETH }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ETH } }
        c:ETH = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Clear temporary excavation strain & Suez construction modifiers upon canal opening.
oe_red_clear_canal_works = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_red_canal_fiscal_strain } remove_country_modifier = oe_red_canal_fiscal_strain }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_red_canal_guild_debt } remove_country_modifier = oe_red_canal_guild_debt }
    if = {
        limit = { owns = location:suez }
        location:suez = {
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_survey_camp } remove_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_survey_camp }
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_corvee_unrest } remove_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_corvee_unrest }
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_guild_works } remove_location_modifier = oe_red_suez_guild_works }
        }
    }
}

# Fire event $ev$ to the best target among ROM / BYZ / MAM / ETH (prefers human player).
oe_red_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_ai = no } }
        c:ROM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MAM c:MAM = { is_ai = no } }
        c:MAM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ETH c:ETH = { is_ai = no } }
        c:ETH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MAM }
        c:MAM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ETH }
        c:ETH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_red.$ev$ }
    }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_cnt add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_m value = oe_red_m_now }
}

# Monthly tick (scheduler slot 53, also called by oe_red_fallback_pulse if BYZ falls or slot 53 not yet wired).
# Takes NO BYZ main-line lock; idempotent per calendar month via oe_red_ran_m.
oe_red_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_red_ran_m ?= oe_red_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ran_m value = oe_red_m_now }
        oe_red_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_on oe_red_any_alive = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_red_ev_m ?= oe_red_m_now } }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes current_year >= 1365 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_1 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_1 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 1 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes current_year >= 1435 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_2 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_2 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 2 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes current_year >= 1448 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_3 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_3 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 3 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1465 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_4 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_4 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 4 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1478 has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_4 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_5 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_5 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 5 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1492 has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_5 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_6 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_6 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 6 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1508 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_7 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_7 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 7 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1535 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_8 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_ev_8 value = 1 }
                    oe_red_dispatch = { ev = 8 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1550 has_global_variable = oe_red_ev_8 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_red_on
            }
        }
    }
}

}
